chunks: The spoils are also for the poor emigrants who were deprived of their homes and possessions and are seeking the bounty and protection of God, and are helping God and His Apostle. They are the ones who are true of word and deed.
ai.seo_question: Who are the poor emigrants and why are they entitled to the spoils of war?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the right of the Ahl al-Bayt to the khums, as the 'poor emigrants' are often interpreted to include the Prophet's family who possessed no fixed inheritance. It underscores their unique status as those who sacrificed material wealth for divine pleasure, distinguishing them from other recipients of war booty and affirming their sincerity in supporting God and His Messenger.
